name: bacasync
description: Aplicacion de sincronizacion de archivos multiplataforma estilo GoodSync

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const d=p.join('dist','renderer');if(!fs.existsSync(d))fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});const source=p.join('src','renderer');const files=['index.html','styles.css'];for(const f of files){const s=p.join(source,f);if(!fs.existsSync(s)){console.warn('SKIP falta origen:',s);continue;}const t=p.join(d,f);try{fs.copyFileSync(s,t);const sz=fs.statSync(t).size;console.log('[build renderer OK]',t,sz,'bytes');}catch(e){console.error('ERROR copiando',f,e&&e.message||e);process.exit(1);}}const extraFiles=['app.js'];for(const f of extraFiles){const s=p.join(d,f);if(fs.existsSync(s)){console.log('[build renderer TS OK]',s,fs.statSync(s).size,'bytes');}else{console.warn('FALTA (todavia no compilado?)',s);}}console.log('[build] renderer listo:');fs.readdirSync(d).forEach(f=>{const s=p.join(d,f);const st=fs.statSync(s);console.log('  -',f,st.size,'bytes');});"
scripts.build:icons: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const run = (f) => { const j = p.join('assets', f); if (fs.existsSync(j)) { try { require('child_process').execFileSync('node', [j], { stdio: 'inherit' }); return true; } catch (e) { console.error('Failed', j, e && e.message || e); process.exitCode = 1; return false; } } return false; }; const runBoth = (base) => run(base+'.js') || run(base+'.cjs'); const a = runBoth('generate-icons'); const b = runBoth('build-icons'); if (!a || !b) process.exit(process.exitCode || 1);"
scripts.prepack: npm run build && (npm run build:icons || true)
scripts.prepack:win: npm run build && (npm run build:icons || true)
scripts.prepack:mac-x64: npm run build && (npm run build:icons || true)
scripts.prepack:mac-arm64: npm run build && (npm run build:icons || true)
scripts.prepack:all: npm run build && (npm run build:icons || true)
